info.title: ChangeCars API
info.description:
Automotive marketplace API: vehicle search, listings, dealers, CRM, valuations, dealer bidding, finance tools, content and notifications.

Errors always use `{ statusCode, code, message, details?, requestId }`. Lists use `{ data, meta: { page, pageSize, total, pageCount } }`.

categoryIds.description: Extra category ids; body and fuel categories are assigned automatically
